SABYASACHI MISHRA


Project Manager | PMP® Certified


+91-7749837873


msabyasachi58@gmail.com


EXPERIENCE


Project Manager


Logic-Square Technology


01/2022 - 09/2025 
	•
Led cross-functional teams comprising software developers, 
designers, QA engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver 
enterprise web applications using Agile Scrum



	•
Served as the primary point of contact for clients, translating 
business requirements into actionable project plans and coordinating 
communication across teams



	•
Created detailed project plans, project scope, milestones, timelines, 
resource allocation, dependencies, and delivery roadmaps



	•
Assigned work, monitored sprint progress, conducted sprint 
planning, stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives while 
ensuring quality and timeline adherence



	•
Managed project documentation including BRDs, FRDs, RAID logs, 
release notes, sprint reports, and status reports



	•
Identified and mitigated risks, scope changes, dependencies, and 
resource constraints through proactive stakeholder communication



	•
Continuously improved delivery processes using retrospective 
insights and Agile metrics



	•
Worked closely with MERN Stack teams (MongoDB, Express.js, 
React.js, Node.js) through requirement discussions, sprint planning, 
testing coordination, and production deployments








PROJECTS


Closewise - FinTech Digital Signing Platform


	•
Managed end-to-end delivery of an enterprise FinTech platform 
leading a team of 10-12 members and 3 vendors with $200K-$400K 
budget



	•
Achieved 90-95% on-time milestones and 90%+ sprint predictability






Grouped - Fan Community Platform


	•
Led Agile Scrum delivery, coordinating cross-functional teams and 
achieving 93-97% on-time releases with improved sprint velocity






Smoothire - Applicant Tracking System


	•
Managed end-to-end ATS development, collaborating with 
developers, QA, and stakeholders to automate recruitment 
workflows and improve hiring efficiency






Stronger Veteran - GovTech Platform


	•
Delivered GIS-based analytics platform for public-sector 
stakeholders






Konnect - Peer-to-Peer Car Rental Platform


	•
Coordinated rapid product delivery, testing cycles, and successful 
launch






Project Deck


	•Led development of a project management platform with 
collaboration and reporting capabilities








SUMMARY


PMP® Certified Project Manager with 4 years of 
experience leading end-to-end software 
delivery across FinTech, HRTech, GovTech, 
Social Media, and Marketplace products. 
Experienced in managing cross-functional 
teams of developers, designers, QA engineers, 
and vendors while acting as the primary client 
point of contact. Skilled in Agile/Scrum project 
execution, project planning, scope 
management, stakeholder communication, 
enterprise SaaS delivery, and continuous 
process improvement






SKILLS


Core Competencies


End-to-End SDLC


Agile Scrum


Client & Stakeholder Management


Project Planning & Roadmaps


Sprint Planning & Release Management


Cross-functional Team Leadership


Scope, Budget & Resource Planning


Risk, Issue & Change Management


Requirements Gathering (BRD/FRD)


Project Documentation
